metadata.title: Manual para el uso de la herramienta e-Reporting Industria (MSP, Unidad de Farmacovigilancia)
metadata.edition: Version V05 (upload of September 2026) · domestic events only, follow-up reports, literature reference, E2B(R3) upload (Spanish)
